svg.aria-label: RescueLens: Identifies cars at crash sites. Names a car’s make, model and year from one photo and shows rescuers where its high voltage runs. When it isn’t sure, it says so instead of guessing. Built for: CV Hackathon 2026. Key result: 94.55% top-1. Built with: PyTorch, YOLO11, ONNX.
